assumptions.choice: Fast EMAs crossing slow EMAs and forming an ordered sequence is implemented as the current bar satisfying EMA(8) > EMA(13) > EMA(21) > EMA(34) > EMA(55) while the previous bar did not satisfy this condition.
assumptions.reason: This captures both the alignment requirement (fast above slow) and the transition (crossover event).

assumptions.choice: The opposite crossover/stopping being ordered is implemented as the current bar failing the strict sequence condition EMA(8) > EMA(13) > EMA(21) > EMA(34) > EMA(55).
assumptions.reason: When any fast EMA drops below another fast EMA or below a slow EMA, the ribbon breaks its bullish ordering, signaling an exit.

assumptions.choice: Position size is computed by allocating 2% of current total portfolio value to the position (size = int(0.02 * portfolio_value / price), with a fallback to 1 share if cash allows).
assumptions.reason: The spec prescribes calculating position size as 2% of total trading capital.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss (2% below) and take-profit (4% above) are calculated dynamically from the actual executed entry price once the buy order fills, placed as OCO stop and limit sell orders.
assumptions.reason: Using actual executed price ensures exact percentage distances relative to position fill price.
